verdict.rationale: TWC documents an online sign-in path for its tax applications. A user ID and password work for both UTR and UTS, and registration is a free online service, so an authorized human can use a credential login remotely. Nothing in the evidence describes MFA, and nothing rules out a mailed PIN or identity-proofing step. The application host also could not be probed, so the actual sign-in flow is unverified. Missing for 10: documented MFA factor(s) on sign-in, explicit confirmation that no biometric/in-person/mailed-PIN step is required, hands-on verification of the login flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: You can use the same user ID and password to access UTR and UTS.
Registering is easy with Unemployment Tax Registration (UTR), TWC's quick and free online service.
If you are liable, you will immediately receive a TWC tax account number.
